theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rdb_firstVariation_le_variationMeasure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (W : Set (Euclidean N)) (Y : Euclidean N → Euclidean N) (K : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → tsupport Y ⊆ W → (∀ z, ‖Y z‖ ≤ K) → ENNReal.ofReal |V.firstVariation Y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal K * variationMeasure V W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
